The '''Military Oversight Committee''' was a committee of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> and the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SBP1">{{SWMiniCite|set=Starship Battles|parent=1}}</ref>

==History==
It was concerned with military spending required to defend constituent [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. It oversaw the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]], Planetary Defense Forces and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="RASB" />

During the development of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] wanted to avoid a controversy in the Senate about the ship's role and its commissions were given falsified information about the class, portraying it as a [[Super-class Star Destroyer|much smaller vessel]] with a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] designation.<ref name="SBP1" />

The Senate Military Oversight Committee continued under the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] but was ultimately modified under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], becoming the [[Imperial Military Oversight Commission]] and placed under the the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="RASB" />
